name: Last Over
summary: A floodlit cricket timing game: swing as the ball arrives to hit sixes and chase the target in six balls
about: A full night-match page with floodlights that flicker on, a crowd that jumps for boundaries and a broadcast-style scorebug and speed gun. The bowler runs in with yorkers, bouncers and slower balls, and your timing decides everything: perfect is six, close is four, and a wild swing sends the stumps cartwheeling. Each won chase moves you to a tougher match with a higher target and quicker bowling.
how: A demo innings plays on load; press Bat now, Take strike, Space or tap the ground to take over.
Press Space, Enter or the round Swing button the moment the ball reaches the bat.
Perfect timing scores six, a little off scores four, two or one, and a miss on the stumps is bowled.
Score the target inside six balls with two wickets to win the match and move to a faster bowler.
The timing bar shows how early or late each swing was; P or Escape pauses and R restarts.
Your best score is kept on this device, and reduced motion calms the crowd, shake and fireworks.
